_note: The languages the Settings screen offers. English is the source text itself (the msgid in src/ui, the value in a data row), so it has no table; every other language has data/i18n/<code>/ui.json and one <kind>.json per data directory it overrides. See docs/localisation.md. `plural_forms` is how many forms a plural msgid has; `decimal` is the decimal separator Num prints.
